english.title: Unauthorised assessable processing by controller
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a data controller, carried out unauthorised assessable processing in respect of

(A)_[a notification under section 18]_
(B)_[notification regulations by virtue of section 20]_

of the Data Protection Act 1998 before the end of

(C)_[a 28 day period]_
(D)_[an extension to a 28 day period specified by the Commissioner]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 22(6) and 60(2) of the Data Protection Act 1998.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
